function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey. It should be format as city name such as Boston.

end_location.description: The destination for the journey. It should be format as city name such as Boston.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey. Default is an empty list.
